Thought: When nitriles undergo hydrolysis in the presence of an aqueous base, they form carboxylic acid salts. This is because the base hydrolyzes the nitrile group (-C≡N) to form a carboxylate ion, which is the salt of the corresponding carboxylic acid. The carboxylic acid itself is not directly formed unless the reaction is carried out under acidic conditions. Thus, the correct answer is the formation of carboxylic acid salts.
